name: MinIO
description: S3-compatible object storage. The console and the S3 API are separate ports because they are separate audiences.

access.note: The routed address serves the S3 API, not the console: applications use the root user as the access key and the generated root password as the secret key. The console runs on a second port this deployment never publishes, so there is no browser sign-in here.

retired: Retired 2026-09-22. Upstream archived the repository, the Docker Hub repository this definition pointed at no longer exists, and there is no newer community release to move the pin to — so the one pullable image stays on the wrong side of a known privilege-escalation fix. The console also never reached the operator: only the primary proxied port becomes a route, and that port is the S3 API.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain for the S3 API

secrets.name: root-password
secrets.label: Root password
secrets.description: Generated here. The upstream default would otherwise be public knowledge.

update.notes: MinIO upgrades read the existing data directory; downgrading across a release is not supported.
